rules.rule: The final score is the Players percentile (shop ALL + buyer ALL for the same GitHub account) on the board at 11/17 23:59. Every component is a percentile of a cumulative total among ranked players only (buyers with a deal, shops with a deal or a purchase; missing values count as 0, ties count half, and stars use stars_rank), so only our relative position against competitors counts.
rules.harness: Optimize and report the combined Players percentile (shop ALL + buyer ALL) and its component percentiles against ranked competitors for the 11/17 23:59 deadline.

rules.rule: The course evaluation weights are 40% for the model criterion, 30% for structural originality, and 30% for ranking. The required base condition is at least 20 settled deals each for the shop and the buyer.
rules.harness: Track settled deals for the shop and the buyer separately to ensure each reaches at least 20, and align design evaluations with the 40% model, 30% structural originality, and 30% ranking weights.

rules.rule: Score opportunity for a component is weight * (1 - percentile), with distance to the next player's value reported. In harness v5 (11/5), strategic priority is set by a ranking forecast to 11/17 23:59: extrapolate recent 6-hour growth rates for our agent and the 5 ranking neighbors above and below, recalculate percentiles, and compute how much the final ALL percentile rises if a component increases by X per day (using board-ours.jsonl and the current snapshot labeled as an estimate when 6-hour history is unavailable).
rules.harness: Expose each component's value, percentile, weight * (1 - percentile) opportunity, and distance to the next player; forecast 11/17 23:59 percentiles from 6-hour growth rates of our agent and +/-5 neighbors, and rank priorities by the marginal ALL percentile gain from adding X per day.
rules.history: v4 / system_card used current weight * (1 - percentile) and next-bracket distance; harness v5 (2026-11-05 draft) added 6-hour linear extrapolation to 11/17 23:59 with +/-5 neighbors and marginal ALL gain per +X/day.

rules.rule: The user's seller priority (11/4 02:2x, strategy v19) is to recover the early loss by selling many units at a profit, judging strategy changes by settled deals and profit per deal.
rules.harness: Prioritize profitable unit volume on the seller side and evaluate strategy changes by settled deals and profit per deal.
rules.history: 2026-11-03 13:44 initial thesis was exposure first, spread honest information, then adjust prices; 2026-11-04 02:09 (strategy v19) focused on winning back the early loss by selling many units at a profit, later refined into S7.
